## About me
Over the years, my approach to software development has evolved: today, I don't just write code, I strive to code with purpose. I'm fascinated by the intersection of things—whether that's crafting intuitive, pixel-perfect frontend experiences or diving deep to understand how highly complex, large-scale systems work under the hood. I'm a continuous learner at heart, always exploring system design, and I truly believe in giving back by actively collaborating with the open-source community
